title_zh: AI 工具与学生独立能力
prompt:
Some people think that AI study tools help students learn more efficiently, while others believe they weaken students' ability to think independently.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
outline_hint: Introduce the disagreement and state the view you will argue for.
View 1: efficiency — instant feedback, personalised practice, wider access.
View 2: dependence — drafting outsourced, weaker persistence, doubts about authorship.
Your position: tools amplify learning only when students must show their working.
Conclusion: what schools should require alongside tool use.
